tools.description: Get a one-time link_url where the user connects (or replaces) their own OpenProject account — they enter their personal access token on that page, never in the chat. pm_link_status already returns a link_url when the account is not linked; use this tool to replace an existing link or token. Give the user exactly the returned link_url — never build a link yourself and never send the user to the OpenProject instance or its API. It is valid for about 10 minutes and only once. Afterwards call pm_link_status. No arguments.
tools.name: pm_link_account

tools.description: Check whether the user's OpenProject account is linked. Linked: tell the user the linked name/login so they can spot a wrong account. Not linked: the result contains a one-time link_url — give the user exactly that URL (never build one yourself); they enter their personal access token there, never in the chat, and the page shows right away whether it worked. Then call pm_link_status again. No arguments.
tools.name: pm_link_status

tools.description: Remove the user's linked OpenProject personal access token. No arguments.
tools.name: pm_unlink_account

tools.description: List OpenProject's statuses, types, priorities, and time-entry activities in one call — the values needed to fill in status/type/priority fields on pm_create_work_package/pm_update_work_package, or the activity field on pm_create_time_entry/pm_update_time_entry. Served from a cache refreshed every ~30 minutes. Optional: kind ("statuses"|"types"|"priorities"|"activities"|"all", default "all").

kind.description: Which reference list to return. Defaults to all four.

tools.name: pm_list_reference_data

tools.description: Resolve people by name/email for assignee/responsible fields, or list a project's members. Served from a cached directory refreshed every ~5 minutes. Optional: query (free-text name/email match), project (id or identifier, scopes to that project's members).

project.description: Project id or identifier to scope results to that project's members.

query.description: Free-text match against name or email.

tools.name: pm_list_users

tools.description: List/search visible OpenProject projects. Optional: search (matches name or identifier).

search.description: Free-text match against project name or identifier.

tools.name: pm_list_projects

tools.description: Get one project's summary, optionally including its members (who's on it). Required: project (id or identifier). Optional: include_members (bool, default false).

include_members.description: When true, also return the project's members and their roles.

tools.name: pm_get_project

tools.description: List work packages with structured filters (project, status, assignee, type, priority, date ranges). Use pm_search_work_packages instead for free-text relevance search. No required arguments (an empty call lists everything visible).

group_by.description: Field to group results by, e.g. "status": adds groups [{value, count}] over the whole result.

limit.description: Max results per page (default 50, hard ceiling 200).

open_only.description: Restrict to not-closed work packages (statuses with is_closed=false, see pm_list_reference_data). An explicit status still applies.

project.description: Project id or identifier to scope results to.

select.description: Restrict each result to these field names (id, subject, status, type, priority, assignee, project, due_date, ...).

status.description: Status name (case-insensitive) or id, or "open"/"closed". Unknown names are rejected with the valid list.

type.description: Work package type name (case-insensitive) or id.

tools.name: pm_list_work_packages

tools.description: Search work packages by free text, optionally combined with the same structured filters as pm_list_work_packages. Required: query.

group_by.description: Field to group results by, e.g. "status": adds groups [{value, count}] over the whole result.

limit.description: Max results per page (default 50, hard ceiling 200).

open_only.description: Restrict to not-closed work packages (statuses with is_closed=false, see pm_list_reference_data). An explicit status still applies.

project.description: Project id or identifier to scope results to.

select.description: Restrict each result to these field names (id, subject, status, type, priority, assignee, project, due_date, ...).

status.description: Status name (case-insensitive) or id, or "open"/"closed". Unknown names are rejected with the valid list.

type.description: Work package type name (case-insensitive) or id.

tools.name: pm_search_work_packages

tools.description: Get one work package by id or display id (e.g. "AIS-469"), including its full description. Required: id. Optional: text_limit (truncate the description).

id.description: Work package id or display id (e.g. 17806 or "AIS-469").

text_limit.description: Truncate the description to this many characters.

tools.name: pm_get_work_package

tools.description: Create a work package. Required: project (id or identifier), type (name or id), subject. Optional: description, status, priority, assignee (id, login, or "me"), parent (id or display id), start_date, due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), estimated_time (ISO-8601 duration, e.g. "PT8H").

parent.description: Parent work package id or display id.

tools.name: pm_create_work_package

tools.description: Update fields on an existing work package (status, priority, assignee, subject, description, dates). Required: id. At least one other field should be set. lock_version is fetched automatically if omitted.

id.description: Work package id or display id (e.g. 17806 or "AIS-469").

tools.name: pm_update_work_package

tools.description: Add a comment to a work package. Required: id, comment. Optional: notify (bool, default false).

id.description: Work package id or display id (e.g. 17806 or "AIS-469").

tools.name: pm_comment_work_package

tools.description: List the comment/activity log for a work package, oldest first (limit keeps the most recent entries). Required: id (or display id). Optional: limit, text_limit (truncate each entry).

id.description: Work package id or display id (e.g. 17806 or "AIS-469").

tools.name: pm_list_work_package_activity

tools.description: List a work package's relations (blocks, precedes, relates to, ...). Required: id.

id.description: Work package id or display id (e.g. 17806 or "AIS-469").

tools.name: pm_list_work_package_relations

tools.description: Create a relation between two work packages. Required: id, related_to_id, relation_type (one of relates, blocks, blocked, precedes, follows, duplicates, duplicated, includes, partof, requires, required).

id.description: The work package the relation is created from (id or display id).

related_to_id.description: The work package to relate to (id or display id).

tools.name: pm_create_work_package_relation

tools.description: List saved boards (work package views). Optional: project (id or identifier, scopes to that project's boards), search (name match).
tools.name: pm_list_boards

tools.description: Get a board's definition (columns/filters/group_by) and, by default, the work packages it currently matches — OpenProject boards are saved filtered views, not separate swimlane resources. Required: id. Optional: include_work_packages (default true), limit.
tools.name: pm_get_board

tools.description: List meetings. Optional: project (id or identifier), from/to (YYYY-MM-DD, filtered client-side — the OpenProject API has no server-side date filter for meetings yet), state (open|draft|in_progress|cancelled|closed).
tools.name: pm_list_meetings

tools.description: Get a meeting with its full agenda, flattened: sections → agenda items → outcomes (minutes/action items) in one readable tree. Required: id. Note: OpenProject's current API exposes no participants/attendees relation — attendee lists are not available here.
tools.name: pm_get_meeting

tools.description: Create a one-time meeting (recurring meetings are not supported by this tool). Required: project, title. Optional: start_time (ISO-8601 datetime), duration (ISO-8601 duration, e.g. "PT1H"), location.
tools.name: pm_create_meeting

tools.description: Add an agenda item to a meeting, or record an outcome (minutes/action item) on an existing agenda item. Required: meeting_id, and either title (creates a new item) or agenda_item_id (attaches an outcome to that item). Optional: work_package_id (links the new item to a work package), notes (item notes, or the outcome text when targeting agenda_item_id), outcome_kind ("information"|"work_package", only meaningful with agenda_item_id).

work_package_id.description: Work package to link the new agenda item to (id or display id).

tools.name: pm_add_meeting_agenda_item

tools.description: List logged time entries with structured filters. No required arguments: without project/work_package_id it lists every entry the user can read across all projects (scope with spent_on_from/spent_on_to). Optional: project, work_package_id (id or display id), user (id, login, or "me"), spent_on_from/spent_on_to (YYYY-MM-DD range), limit, offset (page number). work_package_id is filtered client-side (OpenProject's API has no server-side filter for it), so scope with project/spent_on_from/spent_on_to when possible to keep the scan small.

limit.description: Max results per page (default 50, hard ceiling 200).

work_package_id.description: Work package id or display id (e.g. 17806 or "AIS-469").

tools.name: pm_list_time_entries

tools.description: Log time spent on a work package or project. Required: activity, spent_on (YYYY-MM-DD), and at least one of work_package_id/project, plus either hours (ISO-8601 duration, e.g. "PT8H") or both start_time and end_time (hours is computed locally from the clock times; OpenProject always derives the end time itself and never accepts it directly). Optional: comment, user (log on behalf of another user — id, login, or "me"), start_time alongside hours to also record when the work began, ongoing (bool, only valid with start_time and no end_time — marks the entry as still running). start_time/end_time only work if the OpenProject instance has "allow tracking of start and end times" enabled.

end_time.description: ISO-8601 date-time work ended — used only to compute hours locally, never sent to OpenProject.

ongoing.description: Mark as still running. Only valid with start_time and no end_time.

spent_on.description: Date the time was spent, YYYY-MM-DD.

user.description: Log time on behalf of this user (id, login, or "me"). Defaults to the caller.

work_package_id.description: Work package id or display id (e.g. 17806 or "AIS-469").

tools.name: pm_create_time_entry

tools.description: Update an existing time entry. Required: id. Optional: activity, spent_on, hours, comment, ongoing, start_time+end_time together (to recompute hours from clock times), user. lock_version is fetched automatically if omitted.

end_time.description: Requires start_time in the same call; hours is recomputed locally.

tools.name: pm_update_time_entry

tools.description: Delete a time entry. Required: id.
tools.name: pm_delete_time_entry
